title: scYeast: a biological-knowledge-guided foundation model on yeast single-cell transcriptomics

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Though large-scale pre-trained models are vital for foundational cell modeling, most of them focus on human or mouse systems, with less emphasis on model organisms like yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), and fail to use existing biological prior knowledge effectively.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《scYeast: a biological-knowledge-guided foundation model on yeast single-cell transcriptomics》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Though large-scale pre-trained models are vital for foundational cell modeling, most of them focus on human or mouse systems, with less emphasis on model organisms like yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), and fail to use existing biological prior knowledge effectively.

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Here, we present scYeast, the first foundational cell model for yeast single-cell transcriptomics that effectively embeds biological priors. scYeast employs a novel asymmetric parallel architecture to infuse transcriptional regulatory information into the Transformer's attention mechanism, leveraging biological knowledge during training.

evidence.text: Though large-scale pre-trained models are vital for foundational cell modeling, most of them focus on human or mouse systems, with less emphasis on model organisms like yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), and fail to use existing biological prior knowledge effectively.

Here, we present scYeast, the first foundational cell model for yeast single-cell transcriptomics that effectively embeds biological priors. scYeast employs a novel asymmetric parallel architecture to infuse transcriptional regulatory information into the Transformer's attention mechanism, leveraging biological knowledge during training.
